title: Binning gaze samples into a heatmap
description: You can read how coordinates become counts on a screen-sized grid.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: hist2d receives the x and y gaze columns. You divide the screen range into the supplied bins and select the hot color map.

steps.question: Which vertical direction do these axis limits establish?
steps.answer: They place zero at the top and SCREEN_H at the bottom by reversing the y-axis limits.

steps.description: You title the plot as a gaze heatmap. The colorbar labels the encoded quantity as samples per bin.
show requests the completed figure. The supplied recording has no text output or bin counts to inspect.
